page.overview:
What is Global Defense Agency?

The Global Defense Agency (G.D.A.) is a covert paramilitary organization, law enforcement body, and intelligence agency tasked with monitoring and neutralizing global superhuman threats. Operating from a subterranean headquarters beneath the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, the G.D.A. maintains strong ties to the United States federal government, though its operational jurisdiction extends worldwide.

The agency is responsible for shielding Earth from criminal, extraterrestrial, paranormal, and supernatural crises. To combat organized super-crime, supervillain terrorism, kaiju attacks, and alien invasions, the G.D.A. directly bankrolls the Guardians of the Globe and frequently contracts independent superheroes across the planet.

The Global Defense Agency is primarily funded and staffed by the United States, yet its operational reach transcends all national borders. Armed with global assets, the G.D.A. can project power from the deepest expanses of outer space to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis.

To neutralize threats, monitor superpowered entities, and safeguard Earth, the G.D.A. deploys a vast arsenal of cutting-edge facilities, specialized vehicles, and advanced technology, much of which is of highly questionable ethical origin. These technological assets are engineered to supplement, or entirely substitute for, the capabilities of traditional superheroes.

Also known as: GDA.
